services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Reservations required, minimum of 3 consecutive days required. Renters must have boating experience. Boating safety and operators’ skills/experience operating in the ocean are required to rent. The 22′ Wooldridge is set up to fish and seat 4 people. (5 people maximum occupancy) The War Wagon has a 300 hp Suzuki main engine and a 9.9 hp Suzuki trolling

blurb: Family owned and operated boat rental company in Ketchikan, Alaska. Offers boat rentals for fishing salmon, halibut, and other bottom fish or for sightseeing wildlife like whales, seals, and orcas. Independent and not affiliated with any lodge or marina; guests can stay wherever they like on the island or at approved cabins.
